description: Crypto options from Deribit's public data: each expiry's at-the-money implied volatility, call and put open interest, put/call ratio and the day's volume, with DVOL (Deribit's 30-day implied volatility index) for BTC and ETH; or one expiry's chain, strike by strike, with bids, asks and implied volatilities in US dollars. BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP and others.

currency.description: The coin: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB and others Deribit lists options on.

expiry.description: For chain: the expiry date; default the nearest at least a day away.

view.description: summary: every expiry's at-the-money volatility, open interest and volume, with DVOL. chain: one expiry strike by strike. Default summary.

name: crypto_options

outputSchema.description: summary rows are expiries; chain rows are strikes with the call's and put's bid, ask, implied volatility and open interest.

title: Crypto options (Deribit)
